name: Rabsca
description: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

moves.name: Revival Blessing
moves.description: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Defense Curl
moves.description: The user curls up and boosts its Defense stat.

moves.name: Sand Attack
moves.description: Sand is hurled in the target's face, lowering the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Struggle Bug
moves.description: The user attacks by struggling against opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Sp. Atk stats.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. This attack becomes more powerful each time it hits.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.description: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Lunge
moves.description: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Power Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.

moves.name: Guard Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.

moves.name: Speed Swap
moves.description: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.description: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.

moves.name: Leech Life
moves.description: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to damage all Pokémon except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Future Sight
moves.description: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

moves.name: Imprison
moves.description: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.description: This move's type and power change depending on the weather at the time the move is used.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by cutting off its movement.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Gravity
moves.description: Enables Flying types or Pokémon with the Levitate Ability to be hit by Ground-type moves for five turns. Moves that involve flying can't be used.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

moves.name: Gunk Shot
moves.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.description: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.description: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Struggle Bug
moves.description: The user attacks by struggling against opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Sp. Atk stats.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

moves.name: Psychic Terrain
moves.description: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

moves.name: Lunge
moves.description: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Expanding Force
moves.description: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Skitter Smack
moves.description: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Poltergeist
moves.description: The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Pounce
moves.description: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Psychic Noise
moves.description: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.
